paragraphs: The F-Type SVR uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 that sits at the top of Jaguar's performance range. It was fitted from 2013 through to the end of the X152 generation's production in 2024, and represents the most powerful engine option offered in the F-Type line-up. The AJ133 is a well-documented engine in Jaguar circles, with timing chain tensioner design being the primary area of attention across the engine family. Jaguar F-Type SVR Engine Compatibility Because the F-Type SVR uses a specific high-output version of the AJ133, correct engine matching is essential — particularly for supercharger, ECU and ancillary compatibility. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Type SVR from 2023 to present. The AJ133 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
